**Manager - Integration Solutioning & Technical Leadership (US Shift)**

Department: Integrations

Reports To: Senior Manager / Director

Location: Hyderabad (Hybrid) - working with clients primarily in North America

Shift: US Shift (aligned to US business hours, 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM IST)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6-10 years

Team Size Managed: 2-4 Technical Consultants (US-shift and cross-region)

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Manager to lead Integrations for a portfolio of US-based clients, working in the US shift. You will lead and grow a team of Technical Consultants responsible for integration solutioning and development — owning technical direction, guiding solution design, and ensuring high-quality delivery of new and enhanced integration interfaces. You will be the primary integrations point of contact for client leadership during US business hours, drive periodic leadership connects through demos and meetups, and step in hands-on to help the team solve complex issues on integration interfaces when needed. Our team already uses AI for solutioning and writing code — as a quick learner, you will deepen and scale this practice across the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* 1. Lead and manage a team of 2-4 Technical Consultants — set priorities, plan capacity, run performance reviews, hire and develop talent, mentor on solutioning, and drive accountability for integration outcomes.

* 2. Own integration solutioning end to end — translate client requirements and change requests into robust designs (APIs, file-based flows, middleware patterns) and guide the team through build and delivery.

* 3. Lead and review the solutioning work done by Technical Consultants — ensure code quality, reusability, maintainability, and alignment with platform and integration standards.

* 4. Act as the technical lead for key integration engagements — drive architecture decisions, design reviews, and complex solutioning discussions with clients and internal stakeholders.

* 5. Drive client leadership connects with US clients through demos and meetups, in their time zone — showcase integration capabilities, walk through solution approaches, align on roadmap priorities, and strengthen executive-level confidence in delivery.

* 6. Own escalations and production issues on integration interfaces during US hours — debug failures, unblock consultants on complex interface problems, restore stable data flows, and communicate status to client stakeholders.

* 7. Stay hands-on with Python and integration tooling to review, guide, and when required, contribute to builds and troubleshooting on integration interfaces.

* 8. Build on the team's existing use of AI for solutioning and writing code — as a quick learner, strengthen AI-assisted design, coding, review, and documentation practices so the team delivers faster with consistent quality.

* 9. Partner with India-based Product/Engineering teams on platform capabilities, ensuring clean handoffs across time zones on integration patterns and enhancements needed for scalable client solutions.

* 10. Build and maintain solutioning standards, reusable patterns, and technical documentation so the team can deliver consistently as engagement volume grows.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 6-10 years of experience in technical consulting, integration solutioning/development, or similar roles within HRTech/SaaS or enterprise software.

* Proven experience managing Technical Consultants or similar delivery teams (3+ years in a people-management role) — including hiring, performance management, quality oversight, and owning delivery outcomes.

* Strong hands-on programming ability in Python — comfortable writing, reading, reviewing, and debugging integration code.

* Solid expertise in system integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, file-based integrations, middleware) with the ability to design and solution complex integration landscapes.

* Demonstrated ability to help teams diagnose and resolve issues on integration interfaces in production environments.

* Experience engaging client leadership through demos, technical meetups, and executive-facing solution discussions.

* Experience working with US/North American clients, and willingness to work the US shift on a sustained basis.

* A quick learner who already uses AI tools for solutioning and writing code (e.g., LLM-based assistants, coding copilots) and can strengthen this practice across a delivery team.

* Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills — able to explain technical designs clearly and lead solution discussions with both technical and leadership audiences.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance leadership responsibilities and hands-on technical contribution.

**Good to Have**

* JavaScript experience — a plus for integration builds, scripting, and related client-side or middleware work.

* Prior direct experience with the Darwinbox platform or similar HRMS/HCM products.

* Exposure to standard and custom integration patterns (SFTP, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware tools).

* Experience scaling AI-assisted solutioning and coding practices across a consulting or engineering team.

**What Success Looks Like**

  

Within the first two quarters, this person will have become the trusted integrations lead for US client leadership, established clear ownership of integration solutioning and development quality across their team, built a strong rhythm of client leadership demos and meetups, helped stabilize and resolve complex integration interface issues, and strengthened the team's existing AI-driven approach to solutioning and coding — leaving behind a high-performing US-shift Technical Consultant team capable of scaling delivery with consistent quality.

title: Retail Cluster Manager
description:
**About Optorium**

Optorium is Hyderabad's leading destination for luxury and premium eyewear, established in 2004 with 5 boutique stores across Banjara Hills, Gachibowli, Secunderabad, and Kukatpally. We carry the world's most prestigious eyewear brands including Gucci, Prada, Tom Ford, Ray\-Ban, Burberry, and more.

We are at an exciting growth inflection point — strong walk\-in traffic, an established brand, and a loyal customer base. We now need a driven, commercially sharp leader to take ownership of business development and marketing strategy across all four branches and deliver aggressive year\-on\-year sales growth.

"This is a P\&L accountability role. The Cluster Head owns the number — revenue targets, YoY growth, marketing ROI, and customer acquisition — across all four Optorium branches in Hyderabad."

**Role Overview**

The Cluster Head will be the senior commercial leader across Optorium's Hyderabad cluster, responsible for driving revenue growth, building and executing the marketing strategy across online and offline channels, and building the brand's dominance in the local luxury eyewear market. This person will set sales targets for each branch, monitor performance daily, lead BTL and ATL campaigns, drive digital growth, and develop new business opportunities — from corporate tie\-ups to brand events and influencer activations.

This is a high\-autonomy, high\-accountability role. You will have direct access to the founders, a budget to execute your plans, and a clear incentive structure that rewards overperformance generously.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Business Development \& Revenue Growth**

* Own the monthly and annual revenue target for all four branches — set branch\-wise sales goals in alignment with overall Optorium business targets
* Identify and develop new revenue streams — corporate gifting programmes, B2B tie\-ups with hospitals, clinics, corporates, hotels, and high\-net\-worth individual networks
* Build and manage relationships with key accounts — concierge services, premium corporate HR departments, and referral partners
* Track competitor activity (Dayal Opticals, Gem Opticians, Specsmakers) and identify market gaps or opportunities for Optorium to exploit
* Develop a structured customer retention programme — loyalty offers, repeat purchase incentives, and premium member benefits
* Identify and evaluate potential new branch locations or pop\-up opportunities for future expansion
* Prepare and present a monthly business development report to the founders with pipeline, deals, and revenue impact

**2\. Sales Target Setting, Monitoring \& Incentive Management**

* Set monthly and quarterly sales targets for each branch and each sales staff member — broken down by brand, category (frames, sunglasses, lenses), and ticket size
* Monitor daily sales performance across branches using POS data and report variances against target with corrective actions
* Design and run monthly branch\-level sales incentive schemes — aligned to the company's monthly \+ annual variable incentive structure
* Conduct weekly sales review calls with branch managers and a monthly in\-person performance review at each branch
* Build a YoY growth dashboard tracking revenue, footfall, conversion rate, average ticket size, and repeat customer ratio per branch
* Identify underperforming branches early and implement focused turnaround plans within 30 days

**3\. Marketing Strategy — Online \& Offline**

* Own the integrated marketing strategy for Optorium across all channels — digital, in\-store, events, PR, and paid media
* Work in close coordination with the Content \& Digital Marketing Executive to ensure all content, SEO, and social media output is aligned to business goals and seasonal campaigns
* Plan and execute a quarterly marketing calendar — aligned to brand launches, festive seasons (Diwali, New Year, Valentine's Day, Summer), and new collection drops
* Manage and optimise the Google Ads and Meta Ads budgets — set target CPL (cost per lead), ROAS (return on ad spend), and walk\-in attribution goals
* Develop Optorium's online presence strategy to build national visibility alongside the dominant Hyderabad local ranking
* Track and report marketing ROI monthly — spend vs. footfall lift, revenue attributed to campaigns, and channel\-wise performance

**4\. BTL (Below the Line) Marketing**

* Plan and execute hyperlocal BTL activations — in\-mall promotions, residential society events, corporate campus drives, and premium apartment complex tie\-ups near each branch
* Organise in\-store brand events — exclusive preview nights, brand ambassador visits, new collection launches, and VIP customer evenings
* Manage the annual in\-store visual merchandising refresh — window displays, POP materials, and brand\-specific display zones aligned to seasonal campaigns
* Coordinate with brand principals (Luxottica, Safilo, etc.) to access co\-branded BTL budgets and promotional materials
* Execute referral and word\-of\-mouth programmes — structured incentives for existing customers who bring new buyers
* Build a database of Hyderabad's premium residential catchments near each branch and execute targeted door\-drop or WhatsApp campaigns

**5\. ATL (Above the Line) Marketing**

* Plan and manage ATL campaigns — OOH (outdoor hoardings near each branch), radio spots on Hyderabad's premium stations, and print in curated luxury lifestyle publications
* Develop seasonal ATL campaigns for key moments — summer sunglass season, festive gifting, and New Year refresh
* Brief and manage creative agencies for campaign concept, design, and production
* Negotiate media buying — hoarding placements, radio slots, and magazine insertions — at optimal rates
* Track ATL campaign impact through footfall data, brand search volume lift, and customer\-reported discovery source

**6\. Digital \& Online Channel Growth**

* Drive Optorium's e\-commerce revenue growth through optorium.in — set monthly online sales targets and work with the digital team to optimise conversion
* Develop and execute a performance marketing strategy — Google Shopping ads, Search ads, Meta retargeting — to drive both online sales and store walk\-ins
* Oversee Optorium's local SEO strategy in coordination with the content team — targeting top\-3 Google rankings for all major brand \+ Hyderabad keyword combinations
* Build and manage influencer marketing strategy — identify, brief, and coordinate Hyderabad\-based luxury lifestyle micro and macro influencers
* Develop a WhatsApp Business strategy for customer segmentation and targeted new collection communications

**7\. Team Leadership \& Branch Management Support**
